subjects.description: A white delivery van double-parked in the ego lane, box-style cargo body with a roll-up rear door, commercial livery on the side panels
subjects.appearance_details: Amber hazard lights flashing on all four corners, slightly dusty paint, rear license plate mounted below the cargo door, small ventilation slats near the roofline
subjects.relationship: Obstacle blocking the ego vehicle's path, forcing a lane maneuver
subjects.location: center foreground, occupying the ego lane ahead
subjects.orientation: Rear of van faces the camera, aligned with direction of travel
subjects.pose: Stationary, parked askew close to the right curb
subjects.state_changes: Grows progressively larger in frame as the ego vehicle approaches, then holds steady once ego stops

subjects.description: Parked passenger cars lining both sides of the narrow city street
subjects.appearance_details: Assorted sedans and hatchbacks in silver, dark blue, and black, reflecting daylight off windshields and hoods
subjects.relationship: Roadside context narrowing the drivable space
subjects.location: left and right foreground to midground along the curbs
subjects.orientation: Parallel-parked, facing away and toward the camera on opposite sides
subjects.state_changes: Slide past the frame edges as the ego vehicle advances, then hold still when ego stops

background_setting: A narrow two-way urban city street lined with mid-rise residential and commercial buildings of brick and rendered facades. Parked cars flank both curbs, leaving a tight drivable corridor. Sidewalks with occasional street trees, lampposts, and utility poles frame the scene. The oncoming lane to the left is empty. Clear daytime sky casts consistent, even lighting over the asphalt, which shows faded lane markings and minor patches. Distant intersection and traffic visible far ahead.

lighting.direction: High sun, front-right, casting light down the street
lighting.shadows: Consistent, sharply defined shadows from parked cars and buildings pooling toward the left of the roadway
lighting.illumination_effect: Crisp, high-contrast daytime illumination with true colors and reflective highlights on vehicle surfaces

aesthetics.composition: First-person driver's perspective centered on the road ahead, van dominating the center as the vanishing point of the street, parked cars leading the eye forward, empty oncoming lane visible to the left
aesthetics.color_scheme: Neutral urban palette of grey asphalt, white and silver vehicles, warm brick tones, blue sky accents, amber hazard-light flashes
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Ordinary, tense-but-mundane urban driving moment; cautious anticipation
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating rhythm of parked cars and lampposts receding down the street

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward-moving dashcam perspective at a moderate speed that brakes smoothly and continuously over two full seconds to a complete stop at 0:03.5, then holds completely static and locked off with no movement of any kind
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from driver's eye view
cinematography.focus: Sharp focus on the road ahead and the double-parked van

context: Autonomous driving / ego-vehicle scenario capturing an urban obstacle-negotiation and stop event

actions.description: Ego vehicle travels forward down the narrow street, approaching the double-parked white van with flashing hazard lights
The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.
Ego vehicle comes to a complete stop directly behind the van, blocking the street, and remains fully stationary; the vehicle is parked and perfectly stationary and the camera does not move at all.

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: Bold dark sans-serif lettering on the white rear cargo door
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Center of frame on the van's rear, visible throughout as van grows larger
text_and_signage_elements.context: Identifies the vehicle as a commercial delivery van

segments.description: Ego vehicle drives forward at moderate speed down the narrow two-way street, van appears ahead in the ego lane with hazard lights flashing
segments.key_changes: Van grows larger; distance closes rapidly

segments.description: The vehicle applies smooth, firm, continuous braking. Its speed decreases steadily through the entire two seconds and it reaches a complete standstill by 0:03.5.
segments.key_changes: Speed falls steadily from moderate to exactly zero across two full seconds; the forward motion of the scene slows visibly frame by frame until it ceases entirely at 0:03.5
segments.camera: Forward dashcam motion decelerating smoothly and continuously, coming to a complete rest at 0:03.5

segments.description: Ego vehicle brakes to a complete stop directly behind the double-parked van, blocking the street, and holds stationary. The camera does not translate at all: the framing is identical from 0:03.5 to 0:05, like a photograph; nothing in the scene moves.
segments.key_changes: Zero motion of any kind; the frame is static and locked off; everything holds exactly the same position in frame
segments.camera: Locked-off stationary camera, zero translation, zero vibration, as if mounted on a tripod in a parked car

temporal_caption: At 0:00, ego vehicle travels forward down the narrow street, approaching the double-parked white van with flashing hazard lights. From 0:01.5 the vehicle brakes smoothly and continuously, its speed falling steadily. By 0:03.5 the vehicle has reached a complete standstill. From 0:03.5 to 0:05 the vehicle is parked and perfectly motionless: the camera does not translate at all and the framing is identical, like a still photograph.
audio_description: Ambient urban soundscape: steady engine hum decreasing in pitch as the vehicle decelerates, the rhythmic tick of the van's hazard lights faintly audible, tire rolling noise fading to silence, distant city traffic and occasional bird calls, ending in the quiet idle of the stopped vehicle.
